## scientific-inquiry-foundation ← finite-fallible-inquiry-necessity

`interpretive` — P92’s finite bound through native relations is retained; P94 fixes the task to test balance and residual accounting and generalizes qualitative blindness to common unaccounted exchange. This input distinguishes mechanism-description premises from scientific necessity.

## scientific-inquiry-foundation ← testing-within-registration

`interpretive` — Registration, refutation and common response supply the use interface; observation and actual calibration retain correspondence obligations.

## scientific-inquiry-foundation ← experiment-needs-return

`interpretive` — Retain conditions of experimentation and transfer without requiring every local achievement to explain its whole formation history.

## scientific-inquiry-foundation ← learning-by-refutation

`interpretive` — Reuse negative and positive induction results; do not reopen the completed local learning mechanisms.

## scientific-inquiry-foundation ← generalization-through-lumping

`interpretive` — Actual correspondence between the grouping and the world constrains generalization; fit alone does not supply it.

## scientific-inquiry-foundation ← identification-where-bounded

`interpretive` — A finite record fixes a course under state bounds; arbitrary finite records do not certify the bound and determinacy.

## scientific-inquiry-foundation ← process-and-frame-as-readings

`interpretive` — Formal correspondences among histories, claims and worlds support immanent explanation without alone proving every inquiry’s full constitution.

## scientific-inquiry-foundation ← tests-fix-likeness-where-determined

`interpretive` — Complete tests fix relational structure where both frames are determined up to likeness; the native branching counterexample blocks unconditional expansion, not the theory itself.

## scientific-inquiry-foundation ← contextual-registration

`interpretive` — Context-indexed descriptions preserve registration; failure to erase context does not imply failure of the entire core to represent science.

## scientific-inquiry-foundation ← counterfactual-is-the-course

`interpretive` — P97 reuses the complete formal interface from finite sensitivity; a construction for a supplied law is not empirical certification of the actual law.

## scientific-inquiry-foundation ← histories-fix-law-up-to-dead-ends

`interpretive` — All endpoint-indexed finite histories determine the step law; admits a history-based rival preserving relational content, without equating the complete family with finite samples.

## scientific-inquiry-foundation ← branching-tests-bisimulation

`interpretive` — Retains the image-finite/full-finite-modal-family structural result; actual apparatus is not thereby able to implement all those tests.

## scientific-inquiry-foundation ← configurations-alike-by-relation

`interpretive` — The existing bridge identifies peripheral bisimulation with the spine relation; no new physical correspondence theorem.

## scientific-inquiry-foundation ← finite-continuation-plans

`interpretive` — Reuses finite viability/observation-branching-plan equivalence and blind/sensing/dependency-change witnesses to distinguish paths from commonly usable operations; preserves the original module scope without claiming a new spine adapter.

## scientific-inquiry-foundation ← timely-response-necessity

`interpretive` — The proved timed bound supplies the concrete command task; actual correspondence and full-core necessity remain separate.

`interpretive` — The laws of mechanism and of systems changing their own rule.

**Producer output:** A projection carries a law exactly where configurations alike go alike; the state has a law of its own exactly where the rule makes no difference.

**Consumer input:** The 理 and meta-level aspects of wisdom.

**Retained conditions:** No premise.

[Connection evidence](experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Mechanism.lean)

## wisdom-root-part-one ← identification-where-bounded

`interpretive` — Bounded identification distinguishes the absence of a universally completed learner from perpetual non-convergence in actual learning; used to check necessity scope.

## worlds-are-runs ← process-and-frame-as-readings

`formal-reuse` — Reuses the law a history shows (Shown), its run (Shown.run), the comparison of a law with it (shown_le_iff, Run.shown_le), a world's moves (World.move) and its run of exchange (World.exchangeRun): a world is a run of the law it shows, and a run on webs and exchanges is a world.

**Producer output:** A history is a run of the law it shows; a law contains the shown law exactly where each step of the history is one of its steps.

**Consumer input:** A world's run of the law it shows; balance as the shown law lying within the law of exchange.

**Retained conditions:** None.

[Connection evidence](experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Unfolding.lean)

## worlds-are-runs ← premises-read-off-the-exchange

`formal-reuse` — Reuses the world with the rest counted (World.withRest) and its balance (World.withRest_balanced), both in Becoming.Reading: with the rest counted, every world's whole web is a run of the law of exchange.

**Producer output:** With the rest counted every world balances.

**Consumer input:** The rest-counted run of exchange of every world's whole web.

**Retained conditions:** None.

[Connection evidence](experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Reading.lean)

## worlds-are-runs ← counterfactual-is-the-course

`formal-reuse` — Reuses the course of a law of exchange (ExchangeLaw.course, levels), reading what has stood (Nonanticipating), feasibility (Feasible), when a course balances (course_balances_iff), and the history as an orbit (next, history, history_orbit).

**Producer output:** The course a law of exchange generates, balanced exactly where feasible under a law of what has stood; its history is an orbit.

**Consumer input:** The course as a world and a run; its generation as the one run of a determined law.

**Retained conditions:** The law reads what has stood (for balance only).

[Connection evidence](experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Counterfactual.lean)

## worlds-are-runs ← how-much-difference-arrives

`formal-reuse` — Reuses the carrying law (ExchangeLaw.carrying), the carried amount (carried) and the balance of its course (carrying_balances): the carried amount is a balanced world's standing, and so the standing of a run of the law of exchange.

**Producer output:** The carrying law, the carried amount and the balance of its course.

**Consumer input:** The carried amount as a balanced world's standing and as a run.

**Retained conditions:** None.

[Connection evidence](experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Propagation.lean)

## worlds-are-runs ← space-and-its-parts

`formal-reuse` — Reuses worlds, their balance (World.Balanced) and the world read by roles (World.ofRoles, with Roles' Flow.roles_balances): formations and conditions as roles of one relatum.

## worlds-are-runs ← recurrence-without-premise

`formal-reuse` — Reuses a determined law's process (Law.process) and its run (Law.run): a course's generation and an orbit are runs.

## worlds-are-runs ← necessarily-drawn-is-not-returning

`formal-reuse` — Reuses that every run of a determined law is the orbit from its start (Branching.law_run_state): a course's generation has one run from the start.
